name: 精品纸包装｜当前采购项目 A+/A · B/C 后备
offer: Custom premium rigid gift boxes, paper shopping bags, corrugated mailer boxes and paperboard inserts/dividers, coordinated as a gift/retail/shipping set when the verified project needs it. Scope is paper packaging; unverified materials, direct food contact, certifications or engineered performance require confirmation. No invented MOQ, price, lead time, capacity or credentials.
ideal_customers: Perfume, fragrance, beauty and skincare brands with current explicit packaging RFQs or replacement-supplier searches
Jewelry/watch and premium accessory brands sourcing gift boxes, paper inserts or coordinated bags for a named current project
Scarf/apparel brands sourcing retail paper bags, premium gift boxes or e-commerce mailers for a named project
Chocolate, tea, coffee and gifting brands sourcing outer paper packaging for already wrapped/sealed products
Verified buyers or authorized design/procurement agencies with a named client project and public evidence they are currently sourcing physical paper packaging
markets: Worldwide: rotate countries and languages; no fixed country restriction
exclude: Inactive/unverifiable companies; marketplace-only stores, social-only profiles, scraped lead lists and guessed emails; packaging/printing suppliers, equipment/raw-material sellers and competitors; generic wholesalers/resellers or agencies without a verified authorized packaging project; giant corporations without a specific accessible sourcing project; personal/non-business contacts and irrelevant job titles; our own GUKA/MTT domains; previously contacted duplicates across identities; replied, opted-out, bounced or SMTP-unknown contacts. Pure sector fit must be labeled EXPLORATORY and kept out of qualified sourcing claims.
concept_library:
为同一个经过验证的产品/项目选择两个真正合适的结构族；不要为了使概念不同而捏造功能。
- 高级磁吸翻盖硬质礼盒：建议用于展示瓶装/美容套装，并配有尺寸相关的纸板插片。
- 可拆卸的盖子和底座（两件式硬盒）：珠宝、围巾、礼品套装；必要时可使用纸板隔板。
- 抽屉/滑轨式硬盒：配件或小型礼品套装；开口间隙适中，展示简洁。
- 可折叠高级硬盒：适用于礼品项目的扁平运输概念；折叠机制和最终结构需要样品。
- 纸板插页、折叠支架、隔板和套筒：匹配物品数量、方向和测量尺寸；避免遮盖产品标签。
- 纸质购物袋：品牌颜色、图案和尺寸需协调一致；提手结构和承重能力需要确认。
- 瓦楞纸邮寄盒：电子商务运输，用于产品或礼品盒；根据需要使用纸板固定和分隔；不保证运输性能。
- 配套礼盒+ 纸质插页+ 购物袋+ 外包装：仅提供项目零售/礼品/运输用途所需的组件。
纸张材质、印刷、烫金、压纹/凹印、纹理、涂层和封口均为可选设计方向，需经供应商/材料/样品确认，并非保证能够实现。请勿声称使用EVA、模塑纸浆、食品接触面、FSC/再生材料或其他认证。食品包装默认为已包装/密封产品的外包装。
design_guidance: Start with the verified project, real SKU/photo, item count, approximate dimensions if sourced, opening experience and retail/gifting/shipping use. Separate facts from assumptions; ask for missing dimensions/material requirements rather than inventing them. Match authentic brand colors and restrained premium styling; keep A/B practical and clearly different within the stated product range. Do not invent a defect in existing packaging, a buyer budget, a tender or a purchasing need. Use paperboard retention concepts without claiming tested protection; food remains wrapped/sealed. Mark all visuals as discussion concepts requiring structural, material and sample validation; do not claim engineering, certification or production approval.
email_extra: First contact only: natural English, 45-80 words, one true project-specific observation, one relevant sentence about THIS sender identity, exactly one easy question. A: ask whether they are still considering packaging suppliers/quotes for the named project. A+: ask one next-step question tied to the stated request. Never say they need packaging on a B/C inference. Do not open with engineering costing or a list of specifications. No artificial praise, invented decision maker, cheapest price, unverified certification/MOQ/delivery commitment, or promised sample availability. No attached-concept claim unless an image is actually attached. Use only this account company/domain/signature/WhatsApp. General inbox: a short relevant forwarding request may replace, not add to, the single question.
cta_examples: Are you still considering packaging suppliers for this project?
Is the quotation window for this project still open?
Would a paper-based box and insert direction fit this brief?

image.prompt:
照片级逼真的高级包装讨论概念，横向，同一经过验证的产品/项目的两种实用方案。
产品：{product}。数量：{count}。请与提供的真实产品照片完全一致：形状、标签、颜色和比例；请勿重新设计或虚构产品。
左侧，A：{a_structure}。 {a_visual}
右，B：{b_structure}。{b_visual}
仅使用建议的硬质礼品盒/磁性盒/掀盖盒/抽屉盒/折叠硬质盒/纸质购物袋/瓦楞纸邮寄袋/纸板内衬系列产品。展示可信的折叠方式、盒盖间隙和纸板固定效果。仅在指定情况下添加配套组件，而非作为不必要的附加组件。包装食品保持独立包装；不暗示与食品直接接触。不作任何假定尺寸、认证材料或测试防护声明。
两种方案均需采用一致的四分之三视角，比例相近且清晰可见；产品摆放和开启方式必须合理。每个方案最多只能使用一次真实的客户品牌名称“{brand}”，不得使用虚构的标志或认证。切勿添加供应商标识、GUKA/MTT 联系方式或无关标签。请勿伪造可持续性、食品安全或质量认证标志。
标签A 和B 较小。页脚：{footer}。场景：{scene}。柔和的自然光，简洁的高级构图。这些是未经批准的视觉方案，需要进行结构/材料/样品验证。

discovery_rules:
Search unit: COMPANY + NAMED CURRENT PROJECT. Search current RFQ / request for quotation / looking for packaging supplier / replacement supplier / new packaging supplier / gift set project with explicit outsourced packaging procurement. Use primary buyer websites, current public procurement notices and public authorized agency/project posts; broaden countries, languages and public sources when results are scarce. Never fabricate candidates or upgrade weak evidence to fill a batch. Brand websites remain the source for publicly verified contact email. Do not use guessed emails or contact personal accounts.
A+: identifiable buyer or verified authorized project owner explicitly requesting packaging quotes/suppliers/replacement, with CURRENT evidence suppliers or quotations are still accepted, plus at least TWO of product, quantity, specifications/drawing/photo, required arrival. All facts need source URL and verbatim evidence. A: explicit packaging demand but current acceptance window not confirmed; only prepare a short natural window-confirmation email. B: real named project but packaging purchasing unproven; keep in BACKLOG. C: sector fit or historical demand only; lower-priority BACKLOG. A product launch, exhibition or Christmas advert alone is never a packaging RFQ. Expired/awarded/closed requests, supplier sales ads, jobs, directories and our own domains are excluded. An agency must have verifiable client/project authority; otherwise keep for manual verification.
For each record preserve source_url, evidence_quote, published_at (unknown if not stated), checked_at, project_name, buyer_role, requested_product, quantity, specifications, arrival_requirement, open_window_evidence, procurement_status and missing_information. Use exact source phrases in requirement fields so they can be checked. Mark unknown explicitly. Do not invent budget, decision maker, deadlines, purchasing intent or authority. Use buyer_role=buyer only for actual buyer evidence. Mark capability_status=needs_confirmation for capabilities beyond verified paper boxes/bags/mailers/inserts; no promises. Product URL must be a real same-brand physical SKU; RFQ/source URL is separate. Prefer 2-4 well-supported projects; return fewer or [] rather than generic brands. B/C must never enter qualified-demand outreach. Avoid repetitive sectors/sources and previously checked domains; rotate sources and countries. Contact one company once across GUKA/MTT.
